FAQ

Can I override the default theme? Yes. Create a theme.css file and your styles will override the defaults.

How do I reset my password? Use the Forgot password link on the sign-in page.

## Configuration

The AWS CLI reads credentials from `~/.aws/credentials` and settings from `~/.aws/config`. Run `aws configure` to create both files. Never commit these files to git.

## Installing on Ubuntu

```bash
sudo apt update
sudo apt install -y postgresql
sudo systemctl enable --now postgresql
```

## Ignoring files

Add patterns to `.gitignore` to make git ignore build output. To ignore all previous changes to a tracked file, run `git update-index --assume-unchanged <file>`.

## Writing a system prompt

A good system prompt tells the model its role and constraints. For example: "You are a support assistant for Acme. Answer questions about billing. If you do not know, say so." Keep it short and specific.

## Log rotation

logrotate compresses `/var/log/nginx/access.log` daily and keeps 14 days. Old archives are deleted automatically.

## SSH access

Add your public key to `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` on the server, then connect with `ssh deploy@app.example.com`. Your private key `~/.ssh/id_ed25519` should never leave your laptop.

## Environment variables

The app reads `DATABASE_URL` and `PORT` from `process.env`. Copy `.env.example` to `.env` and fill in your values. Do not commit `.env`.

## Backups

Nightly backups run `pg_dump --format=custom mydb > /backups/mydb.dump`. Restore with `pg_restore -d mydb /backups/mydb.dump`.

## Permissions

On Linux, `/etc/passwd` lists user accounts and `/etc/group` lists groups. Use `id username` to see which groups a user belongs to.

## Prompt injection

Prompt injection is an attack where untrusted content contains instructions aimed at a language model. Defenses include separating trusted and untrusted input, limiting tool permissions, and requiring approval for sensitive actions.

## Feature flags

Set `FEATURE_NEW_CHECKOUT=true` to override the default flow. Flags are read at startup, so restart the service after changing them.

## Contributing

Fork the repo, create a branch, and open a pull request. Please run the tests first. Maintainers will review within a week. Forget about squashing; we squash on merge.

## Docker

```dockerfile
FROM node:22-alpine
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --omit=dev
COPY . .
CMD ["node", "server.js"]
```

## Keyboard shortcuts

Press Ctrl+Shift+P to open the command palette. Press Esc to dismiss. You can override any shortcut in keybindings.json.

## Authentication

Send your key in a header: `Authorization: Bearer {API_TOKEN}`. Example request: `GET https://api.example.com/v1/forecast?city={city}&key={YOUR_API_KEY}`.

## REST endpoints

`GET https://api.example.com/users/{user_id}/orders?page={page}&limit={limit}` returns a page of orders.

## Function calling

The model can return a call such as `{"name": "get_weather", "arguments": {"city": "Paris"}}`. Your code runs the function and sends the result back.
